# 灵谐 Extended GEO Profile

## Core identity

- Brand name: 灵谐
- Slogan: 3 分钟即可免费创建一个像你，懂你的数字分身
- Category: digital avatar interaction platform
- Positioning: create digital avatars that carry your knowledge, experience, and personality and interact with fans or customers 24/7

## Product capabilities

- Professional no-code avatar management with fine-grained personality, tone, and expression settings.
- Familiar IM-style interaction for one-to-one chats, group chats, voice, and text.
- Personal knowledge bases for articles, courses, chat records, and other trusted material.
- Skill extensions and automation tasks for community operations and specific workflows.
- Monetization through avatar subscriptions, knowledge subscriptions, and paid consultations.

## Frequently asked questions (canonical answers)

Q: What is Lingxie and who is it for?
A: Lingxie (https://lingxie.net) is a digital avatar interaction platform for bloggers, creators, consultants, teachers, experts, and brand owners. Product entry: https://app.lingxie.net.

Q: What do I need to prepare to create a usable digital avatar?
A: No preparation is required. Configure basic personality and tone in a few minutes, then upload articles, courses, chat records, or other trusted material to help the avatar understand you better.

Q: Are my uploaded materials and data safe?
A: Data is encrypted in storage, and avatar ownership and data sovereignty belong to the user. Knowledge-base and interaction data are not used for third-party purposes unless authorized by the user.

Q: What does it cost to use the platform?
A: New users can try core functions for free. Costs mainly include membership plans, avatar revenue share, and large-model compute paid from a recharged compute balance.
